subject: KMS lease model, rotation affinity & operator eviction telemetry
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: ops-security@neptune.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: KMS lease model, rotation affinity & operator eviction telemetry

Hi team,

Following our kickoff call last week, attached is a short proposal that lays out a KMS lease model we think will reduce cross-tenant key churn during scale events and give clear operator eviction signals for Private (VPC) installs. The doc includes:
- lease window definitions (hard/soft leases)
- rotation affinity heuristics (per-deployment, per-tenant, and per-key-class)
- telemetry counters we will expose for eviction/latency triggers

High level asks:
1) Can Neptune security confirm there are no regulatory blockers to keeping short-lived tenant leases (default 24h) with optional manual escrow?
2) PQCloud HSM — can you confirm the ability to export audit counters we propose (listed in the attachment)?

Attachments: kms-lease-proposal-v0.1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages; contains diagram and action matrix)

Proposed next steps: internal review + vendor confirmation this week, then a runbook draft for operator playbooks.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: ops-security@neptune.com
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: KMS lease model, rotation affinity & operator eviction telemetry

Rachel,

Thanks for the note and the proposal. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we loop in procurement/ops:
- Short-lived leases are acceptable from a policy perspective, but we need an explicit path for emergency key recovery that preserves chain-of-custody.
- Can you clarify how you plan to store escrow metadata (on-control-plane vs. customer vault)?
- We want to see sample telemetry payloads (schema + retention). 30 days retention looks fine, but we may request 90 days for forensics on high-risk tenants.

We can set aside time on Monday for an architecture walk if that helps.

—Neptune Ops
ops-security@neptune.com
Information Security | Neptune Therapeutics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, ops-security@neptune.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS lease model, rotation affinity & operator eviction telemetry

Thanks Rachel / Neptune — quick technical notes and a small diagram attached.

Summary:
- Escrow metadata: we recommend customer-managed escrow stored in their HSM-backed vault (BYOK metadata only) and a signed pointer in the Redwood control plane. This keeps the sensitive material off Redwood while giving us a verifiable reference.
- Eviction telemetry: expose three counters and a health state: lease_renew_attempts, lease_miss_count, and eviction_probe_latency_ms. The health state (OK, DEGRADED, EVICTION_POSSIBLE) is derived from thresholds.
- Rotation affinity: keep primary rotation aligned to tenant activity windows (e.g., rotate during low qps windows) and only force cross-tenant rotations when a key compromise is detected.

See rotation-affinity-diagram.png (PNG, 1.2MB) and operator-eviction-metrics.xlsx (XLSX, sample counters and thresholds).

Open questions for PQCloud: can your PKCS#11 interface provide per-session counters for lease_renew_attempts? If not, we will need to augment with an agent-side aggregator.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: pqcloud-hsm@pqcloud.com (PQCloud HSM Integrations)
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-security@neptune.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 13:20:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: KMS lease model, rotation affinity & operator eviction telemetry

Hi all,

PQCloud team here — thanks for the proposal and the detailed metrics list. Quick vendor-side notes:
- PKCS#11 does not natively provide a "lease_renew_attempts" counter per se. We can expose HSM session open/close hooks with timestamps and a custom counter in our management API that approximates renew attempts if Redwood sends session IDs on renew attempts.
- Audit logs retention is configurable; default is 90 days (can be downsampled into 365-day compressed archives).
- We can sign the escrow pointer metadata with a hardware key so Neptune and Redwood can verify authenticity.

We will need a short integration doc to agree wire formats. We can provide an initial draft by Wed.

—PQCloud Integrations
PQCloud HSM Solutions
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-security@neptune.com, pqcloud-hsm@pqcloud.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 08:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS lease model, rotation affinity & operator eviction telemetry

Couple of operator-side constraints to call out:
- Operator eviction needs an explicit "grace window" metric: we should not evict on the first missed lease_renew_attempts spike. Proposed flow: 1) mark DEGRADED at threshold T1, 2) if miss_count continues for window W (30m) and eviction_probe_latency_ms > L, then mark EVICTION_POSSIBLE and queue human review.
- For automation, add an "operator-lock" annotation to prevent eviction during active maintenance (applies to private deployments where ops may run scheduled jobs).
- Telemetry PII: do not send raw tenant identifiers in the metrics feed; use hashed tenant IDs with a salt agreed per customer.

Action items I can pick up: update runbook snippets and add the operator-lock annotation spec.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Product Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — solid feedback. Quick summary and agreed next steps: 
- Neptune: confirm retention window and emergency escrow process (Neptune ops to reply by EOD Thurs).
- PQCloud: integration doc due Wed (confirming ability to emit counters and signed pointers).
- Karthik/Soojin: update runbook snippets for grace-window + operator-lock annotation (Karthik to own, targeted PR by next Wednesday).
- Rachel/Tessa: draft compliance appendix describing hashed-tenant telemetry and chain-of-custody flow.

I'll capture these into a single confluence page and share the link (will add to related_links once created).

Attachments referenced: kms-lease-proposal-v0.1.pdf, rotation-affinity-diagram.png, operator-eviction-metrics.xlsx

Best,
Rachel
